description: Flat metadata schema for a single biosynthetic gene cluster record from soil-derived bacterial genomic analysis, including genomic localization, gene-level annotation, and linked chemical characterization of the antibiotic product.

record_id.descr: Unique internal identifier for this biosynthetic gene cluster record.

strain_id.descr: Identifier of the bacterial isolate/strain from which the genome was obtained.

species_name.descr: Taxonomic assignment of the isolate, if known; use standardized scientific name.

soil_sample_id.descr: Identifier of the soil sample used for isolation of the strain.

soil_collection_site.descr: Name or code for the geographic collection site of the soil sample.

collection_latitude.descr: Latitude of the soil collection site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

collection_longitude.descr: Longitude of the soil collection site in decimal degrees (WGS84).

collection_date.descr: Date when the soil sample was collected.

habitat_description.descr: Brief description of the soil habitat, such as forest soil, agricultural soil, rhizosphere, or desert soil.

isolation_method.descr: Method used to isolate the bacterial strain from soil, such as plating medium or enrichment approach.

genome_accession.descr: Public accession for the assembled genome sequence, if deposited in a repository.

assembly_accession.descr: Accession for the genome assembly version used for biosynthetic gene cluster analysis.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing technology used to generate the genome, such as Illumina, Oxford Nanopore, or PacBio.

assembly_method.descr: Software or pipeline used to assemble the genome.

annotation_pipeline.descr: Genome annotation pipeline used before biosynthetic gene cluster analysis.

cluster_id.descr: Unique identifier for the biosynthetic gene cluster within the genome.

cluster_type.descr: Biosynthetic gene cluster class, such as NRPS, PKS, RiPP, terpenes, siderophore, or hybrid.

product_family.descr: Predicted or known antibiotic product family associated with the cluster.

cluster_novelty_status.descr: Novelty assessment of the cluster, such as known, putative novel, or confirmed novel.

contig_id.descr: Contig or scaffold identifier where the cluster is located.

cluster_start_bp.descr: 1-based genomic start coordinate of the biosynthetic gene cluster on the contig, in base pairs.

cluster_end_bp.descr: 1-based genomic end coordinate of the biosynthetic gene cluster on the contig, in base pairs.

cluster_strand.descr: Genomic strand of the cluster location, use + or - where applicable.

cluster_length_bp.descr: Total length of the cluster region in base pairs.

cluster_completeness.descr: Indicates whether the cluster is complete, partial, or fragmented in the assembly.

gene_ids_in_cluster.descr: Delimited list of gene identifiers belonging to the cluster.

gene_locus_tags.descr: Delimited list of locus tags for genes in the cluster.

gene_product_names.descr: Delimited list of predicted or annotated gene product names for genes in the cluster.

gene_functions.descr: Delimited list of functional annotations for individual genes in the cluster.

gene_domain_architectures.descr: Delimited list of conserved domains or module architectures identified in cluster genes.

gene_enzyme_classes.descr: Delimited list of enzyme class annotations for cluster genes, such as oxidoreductase or transferase.

annotation_database.descr: Database used for gene or cluster annotation, such as antiSMASH, MIBiG, InterPro, Pfam, or NRPS/PKS-specific resources.

annotation_software.descr: Software used to predict or annotate the biosynthetic gene cluster.

annotation_version.descr: Version of the annotation software or database used.

annotation_score.descr: Confidence or similarity score for the cluster prediction or annotation.

annotation_evalue.descr: E-value or equivalent significance metric for annotation hits, if applicable.

percent_identity.descr: Percent identity to the closest known biosynthetic gene cluster or reference gene, if applicable.

coverage_percent.descr: Percent sequence coverage of the reference hit or model, if applicable.

predicted_product_name.descr: Predicted small-molecule product name for the cluster, if known.

predicted_product_structure_description.descr: Free-text description of the predicted product scaffold or structural features.

chemical_compound_name.descr: Name of the chemically characterized antibiotic compound associated with this cluster.

chemical_formula.descr: Empirical molecular formula of the characterized compound, if determined.

exact_mass.descr: Measured or calculated exact mass of the compound in Daltons.

molecular_weight.descr: Molecular weight of the compound in Daltons.

retention_time_min.descr: Chromatographic retention time of the compound in minutes.

msms_supported.descr: Indicates whether MS/MS evidence supports the compound assignment.

nmr_confirmed.descr: Indicates whether NMR or other structural spectroscopy confirmed the compound structure.

purified_compound.descr: Indicates whether the compound was isolated in purified form.

bioactivity_assay.descr: Name of the antimicrobial or bioactivity assay used to test the compound.

bioactivity_target_organism.descr: Test organism used in the antimicrobial assay, if applicable.

mic_value.descr: Minimum inhibitory concentration observed for the purified compound or extract, in the assay unit reported in the accompanying methods.

bioactivity_unit.descr: Unit for the bioactivity measurement, such as ug/mL or uM.

biosynthesis_evidence_level.descr: Overall evidence level for the proposed biosynthetic link between cluster and compound, such as predicted, supported, or experimentally validated.

deposition_link.descr: Identifier or URL linking to external records for the genome, strain, or compound data.

curation_status.descr: Status of manual curation for this record, such as draft, reviewed, or final.

record_created_date.descr: Date when this metadata record was created.

record_updated_date.descr: Date when this metadata record was last updated.
